description:
The king of custom hardtails; the Deluxe is the result of refinement and experience. Each Deluxe is designed specifically for the build height and offset of a specific fork (rigid or suspension), guaranteeing ideal handling characteristics. A combination of Reynolds 853 steel and True Temper OX Platinum can take all of the abuse the trails can offer. A plethora of wall thicknesses, diameters, and butt lengths allow every frame to be unique to its owner.

Designed around a rigid or suspension fork

components.description: Head tube and down tube gusset for optimal strength and stiffness
All tubes are sealed except the seat tube to minimize corrosion (Read about seat tube and frame maintenance)
